mentions.name: Family planner (Weekdoc)
mentions.description: A mobile-first family planner that shows a weekly "what's happening this week" view for the whole family, giving one shared place to track family activities and to-dos. Built heavily with AI-assisted coding (OpenAI Codex) and hosted for free on Cloudflare Pages, Workers and KV store; the build process and guardrails are documented in an accompanying write-up.
mentions.problem: The author is very forgetful and wanted one place to keep the family's things to do.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the holidays I worked on on a simple family planner for my family (mostly for me as I am very forgetful and wanted one place for our family things to do)
